name: trace
description: Your agent builds it. TRACE checks it. Exercises web apps, APIs, CLIs and libraries, collects screenshots and evidence, and proves that fixes work.

interface.shortDescription: Checks what your agent built and proves the fix
interface.longDescription: TRACE runs your web app, API, CLI or library, collects screenshots and other evidence, reports compact findings, and re-runs the same frozen checks after a fix. A pass only counts as a verified fix when the same check failed first. No API keys, no telemetry.
defaultPrompt: Check the feature you just built.
